shadows.name: ambient-glow-btn
shadows.purpose: Primary button, resting state. Deepens to 55% on hover.

shadows.name: ambient-glow-tight
shadows.purpose: Active status pill and attention-count badge — tighter radius than the button glow.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Modal content over the dimmed overlay.

shadows.purpose: Home dashboard and Login page background, dark theme only — two-tone, no pink.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — send, save, confirm. Carries the Ambient Glow shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #5b3df0); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 45%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 85%, black); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 55%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5b3df0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — cancel, dismiss, back. No glow: not accent-colored at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #17171f; border: 1px solid #e4e2ec; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f6f5fb; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5b3df0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pipeline status indicator, one of five semantic colors plus neutral not_contacted. No glow — semantic status colors are separate from the accent.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-badge-confirmed { background: color-mix(in srgb, #059669 18%, #ffffff); color: color-mix(in srgb, #059669 65%, #17171f); }

components.name: Active Status Pill
components.description: The one status pill that IS accent-colored (project is currently active) rather than semantic — carries the tight Ambient Glow.
components.css: .ds-pill-active { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 10%, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #5b3df0); box-shadow: 0 0 12px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 55%, transparent); }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Text field with accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e2ec; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: #ffffff; color: #17171f; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.1s ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #5b3df0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 10%, #ffffff); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5c6b; }

components.name: Nav Link (active)
components.description: Topbar navigation item, showing the active/current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #5c5c6b; transition: background 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #f6f5fb; color: #17171f; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 10%, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #5b3df0); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Pipeline Bar

components.css: .ds-pipeline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 272px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-pipeline-total { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #17171f; } .ds-pipeline-bar { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #e4e2ec; } .ds-pipeline-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; } .ds-ptag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #5c5c6b; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-board-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e2ec; border-radius: 11px; padding: 12px 13px; cursor: grab; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-board-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #5b3df0) 28%, #ffffff); } .ds-board-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-board-card-category { font-size: 10px; color: #5c5c6b; background: #eeedf6; border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 6px; } .ds-board-card-date { font-size: 10.5px; color: #74748a; } .ds-board-card-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #17171f; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-board-card-ask { font-size: 11.5px; color: #5c5c6b; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-board-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-board-card-avatar { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5b3df0; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-board-card-contact { font-size: 11.5px; color: #5c5c6b; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Org Row (status dot)
components.description: Signature Unified Desk component — the inbox sidebar row that keeps pipeline status visible without ever leaving the correspondence view.
components.css: .ds-org-row { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-org-row:hover { background: #f6f5fb; } .ds-org-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ea580c; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-org-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-org-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #17171f; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-org-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: #5c5c6b; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

narrative.overview: Longlist exists because status tracking and actual correspondence are usually two separate tools — a spreadsheet in one tab, Gmail in another. The Unified Desk means every screen puts both on the same surface: the structured layer (project → category → org, status pipeline, kanban columns) is never more than one glance or one click from the real email thread it describes. Board view, inbox view, and dashboard are three lenses on the same underlying data, not three destinations. The visual language carries that job with more confidence than the original MVP skin: crisp and fast, but with a cinematic, keynote-stage polish — a richer violet accent, a soft multi-hue glow on arrival screens, and a deliberate glow on the handful of elements that are actually colored. It still explicitly rejects the cutesy-consumer-app register: no illustration, no mascots, no emoji-driven UI. The richness lives in light, color, and glow — never in ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Every status signal (badge, dot, column) sits beside a direct path into the real thread — never status-only, never email-only
Dense by design on working screens: a long list is meant to look long, not padded out to feel spacious
Cards stay flat and quiet; glow is reserved for colored, functional elements — never a plain surface
Arrival screens (Home, Login) carry a soft multi-hue background bloom; dense working screens stay plain
One accent color carries all functional signal; two fixed atmosphere hues (cyan, pink) live only in the background bloom
Two-voice typography: Space Grotesk for identity/orientation moments, plain system sans for everything the user actually works in

rules.name: The Working Indigo Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only on primary actions, current selection, and functional status signal. It is never used purely decoratively. If a use of the accent can't be explained as "this is clickable" or "this is currently selected," it's wrong.

rules.name: The One Desk Rule
rules.body: A status color never appears without a path to the thread it describes, within one click. A kanban card, org row, or dashboard tile that shows status but not a route into the actual email fails this rule.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk appears only in headings and identity moments. The moment a font choice reaches a button, badge, table cell, or form control, it must be the system sans.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats at rest if it's a plain surface. A shadow on a neutral card is only correct as a direct response to hover or to leaving the page's normal stacking context.

rules.name: The Ambient Glow Rule
rules.body: A resting (non-hover) shadow is only correct on an element that is itself accent-colored — never on a neutral surface, and never as decoration on something that isn't already functionally "the colored thing" on screen.

dos: Do keep the accent to primary actions, current selection, and status/functional signal only — never pure decoration
Do pair every status indicator with a one-click path to the real email thread it describes
Do leave cards and surfaces flat at rest; shadow there only on hover or for floating/overlay elements
Do give accent-colored functional elements a soft resting glow — primary buttons, active status pills, count badges
Do keep the arrival-screen bloom to Home and Login only; dense working screens stay plain
Do keep light mode's arrival bloom far more subtle than dark's (8-13% vs 22-36%) — they are deliberately asymmetric, not mirrored
Do default every new session to light mode, unless the user has explicitly chosen dark before
Do keep Space Grotesk confined to headings and identity moments; system sans everywhere functional
Do derive semantic and status colors via color-mix() toward surface/text rather than fixed hex values
donts: Don't add illustration, mascots, or emoji-driven UI
Don't put a glow or colored shadow on a plain white/dark card — glow belongs on colored elements only
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list rows
Don't add decorative motion — motion here exists only to convey state
Don't introduce a second display font, or pair Space Grotesk with anything other than the system sans
Don't let the Atmosphere hues (Glow Cyan, Glow Pink) leak onto functional UI — they exist only inside the arrival bloom
Don't reintroduce a user-facing accent color picker — the accent is fixed by deliberate choice
Don't default a first-time session to the OS's dark-mode preference — light is the fixed default
Don't hide an org or thread behind pagination or an archive that removes it from every list/board view
